newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovakia to back $200 mln JP Morgan loan.
newsitem.headline: Slovakia to back $200 mln JP Morgan loan.

text.p: The Slovak government on Tuesday approved a state guarantee for a $200 million loan for hydro-construction projects via bank J.P. Morgan, the head of the state-run construction company involved in the deal said.

Julius Binder, general director of hydro-construction company Vodohospodarska Vystavba a.s. told Reuters after a cabinet meeting the 10-year fiduciary loan with an interest of Libor plus 100-125 points would be issued in one tranche.
"The loan is the second part of the $500 million loan agreed with J.P. Morgan and Vodohspodarska Vystavba last year, Binder said.

J.P. Morgan has chosen a fiduciary bank that would would issue and sell bonds with the money chanelled to Vodohospodarska Vystavba through J.P. Morgan, Binder said at the end of a regular government session. He declined to name the bank.
The loan is to finance the completion of the Gabcikovo Danube River dam project and a new dam on the River Vah at Zilina, northern Slovakia.
